cases.prompt: A SwiftUI screen filters one local collection with a closed enum and one business rule. There are no alternative clients, shared lifetimes, or demonstrated variation. Decide whether the feature has earned a GoF pattern.
cases.expected_outcome: Return No pattern yet and retain the direct Swift design.
must_observe: identifies the current observable pressure
describes the smallest direct baseline
states the complexity avoided and one concrete reconsideration signal
must_not: does not invent future growth as pressure
does not introduce protocols or ceremonial participants

cases.prompt: A team proposes Strategy to select a payment provider, but the request does not say whether more than one provider will run in production or who owns its lifetime. Evaluate the decision from the available facts.
cases.expected_outcome: Return Insufficient evidence and request only the material fact that could change the verdict.
must_observe: separates observed facts from forecasts
names the missing variation or ownership fact
avoids selecting a provisional pattern
must_not: does not return a pattern menu or implementation

cases.prompt: A verified Strategy decision covers two current clients, Checkout and Reorder, which select at initialization between StandardDeliveryPricing and CampaignDeliveryPricing. Each policy provides quote(cart:destination:) async throws -> Decimal and isEligible(destination:) async -> Bool. The only domain errors are unavailable and invalidDestination; CancellationError propagates unchanged, while isEligible performs no cancellable suspension. Policies are immutable Sendable values owned for the client lifetime and accept concurrent calls. The direct baseline duplicates one policy switch in both clients. Implement the smallest boundary with behavioral tests.
cases.expected_outcome: Create the minimum justified boundary and tests for pressure, delegation, success, and failure.
must_observe: keeps the direct baseline visible
chooses a minimal representation for immediate variation
covers observable success and error behavior
must_not: does not add containers, factories, or speculative layers
does not test participant names instead of behavior

cases.prompt: Adapt a callback SDK to an asynchronous handler chain, but the request does not define errors, cancellation, callback cardinality, or task ownership. Decide whether implementation can start.
cases.expected_outcome: Return insufficient implementation contract and list the missing facts without producing code.
must_observe: detects that errors, cancellation, and cardinality change the boundary
identifies undefined ownership or lifetime
retains the baseline until the contract is complete
must_not: does not implement provisionally or retain competing architectures

cases.prompt: Write Documentation/Observer/README.md from this verified evidence packet. SessionUpdates.swift contains actor SessionUpdates whose subscribe() returns AsyncStream<SessionState>; each subscriber receives the current state and owns independent cancellation. SessionUpdatesTests.swift proves current-state delivery and that cancelling one subscription keeps the other active. The verified command swift test --filter SessionUpdatesTests reports two passing tests. The direct baseline was one callback with a fixed receiver; the current requirement adds consumers with independent lifetimes.
cases.expected_outcome: Document verified code and tests with the baseline, turning point, diagram, trade-offs, alternative, and When not to use it.
must_observe: verifies names, signatures, commands, and results before claiming them
traces responsibility from one input to an observable result
includes one concrete reversal signal
must_not: does not substitute a generic definition for local evidence
does not claim unmeasured benchmarks or guarantees

cases.prompt: The user wants a Decorator guide from an architecture description alone and provides no compilable code, tests, or execution results. Respond according to the skill entry gate.
cases.expected_outcome: Stop and report the missing evidence without presenting the pattern as earned.
must_observe: requests verifiable code and relevant tests
distinguishes described pressure from executed evidence
routes decision or implementation work to the appropriate skill
must_not: does not invent signatures, commands, or results
does not change architecture to make the guide possible

cases.prompt: Audit this bounded catalogue evidence packet. Adapter has a canonical guide, two incompatible payment SDKs, one app-owned contract, success/error tests, and a direct mapping baseline that duplicates provider vocabulary. Strategy is a historical sketch with one closed enum switch, no second policy, and no tests. The no-pattern case builds one localized share URL with a pure function and passing tests. Classify every entry and determine release readiness without editing anything.
cases.expected_outcome: Return a classification matrix, prioritized findings, and validation limits without modifying the catalogue.
must_observe: establishes the catalogue boundary and source of truth
checks baseline, pressure, implementation, tests, and teaching evidence
separates P0, P1, and P2 severity from tooling limitations
must_not: does not classify from names or diagrams alone
does not edit files, delete history, or publish changes

cases.prompt: The owner requests only a release-readiness review of the supplied catalogue snapshot: one root index, canonical guides, linked tests, and generated headers. Some examples might be corrected later, but no implementation or publication is authorized. Audit the current evidence and state what remains unverified.
cases.expected_outcome: Return findings and a prioritized remediation plan without mutating, publishing, or preparing unrelated changes.
must_observe: inspects consistency, links, tests, and executable evidence
reports absent validators or environments as limitations
separates future recommendations from actions actually performed
must_not: does not modify catalogue code or documentation
does not open a pull request, commit, or publish externally
